data.title: Preview: Gambia vs Ivory Coast - prediction, team news, lineups - Sports Mole
data.content:
Twenty-one-year-old forward Alasana Yirajang remains under disciplinary sanction from the country's FA, having missed the first leg and set to serve a further two-match ban.

Ivory Coast remain without Odilon Kossounou, Guela Doue and Ghislain Konan, who have been unavailable through injury, while Ange-Yoan Bonny withdrew from the squad before the opening encounter. [...] © Imago

Gambia will again be without Alieu Fadera and Adama Sidibeh, while Jesper Ceesay and Suleiman Camara were also unavailable for the double-header after reportedly withdrawing from the squad through injury.

Barrow and Yankuba Minteh have returned after missing September's qualifiers through injury, with the former finding the net in Bouake and the latter featuring after the interval. [...] Emmanuel Agbadou was also carrying a knee problem ahead of Thursday's fixture, although Oumar Solet has since received FIFA approval to represent the Elephants and is eligible for the return meeting.

Wahi is expected to lead the line again after scoring his first international goal, although it remains to be seen whether Renard will rotate his attacking options after Real Madrid's Yan Diomande and Nicolas Pepe provided support from the flanks.

data.title: AFCON 2027: Ivory Coast and Gambia battle for top spot in Group C
data.content:
Gambia will also have to cope with a number of withdrawals. Alieu Fadera and Adama Sidibeh are injured, as are Jesper Ceesay and Suleiman Camara. The latter two have been replaced in the squad by Saidou Khan and Salieu Drammeh.

The two teams will meet again on 17 November for the return leg, scheduled to be played in Gambia. Before that second meeting, the result in Bouaké could already carry weight in the race for top spot in Group C. [...] Skip to content

# AFCON 2027: Ivory Coast and Gambia battle for top spot in Group C

Ivory Coast host Gambia this Thursday 12 November 2026 at the Peace Stadium in Bouaké, in the third round of qualifying for the 2027 Africa Cup of Nations. Both teams have six points from their first two matches. The meeting is the first of two fixtures between the sides, with the return match scheduled for 17 November. [...] Ivory Coast will be able to call on the return of Amad Diallo, who has recovered from a minor fitness concern. However, Odilon Kossounou and Guéla Doué are unavailable because of injuries. Several senior players, including Wilfried Singo, Simon Adingra, Evann Guessand and Sébastien Haller, are also not in the squad.

data.title: Africa Cup Group C Table: Ivory Coast, Ghana
data.content:
Leader. Côte d’Ivoire, 9 points from 3 games, three ahead of Gambia (6) after matchday 3.
 Data. Results from CAF, the Confederation of African Football, to Thursday 12 November 2026. Group C finished matchday 3 that day.
 Next. US Eastern time (ET): Somalia v Ghana, Monday 16 November, 10:00 a.m.; Gambia v Côte d’Ivoire, Tuesday 17 November, 11:00 a.m.
 Qualifying. The top two of four teams reach the finals. Group C has no host team. [...] Matchday 4 brings the return legs of the two matchday 3 games, with Ghana’s game on Monday 16 November 2026 and the top-of-the-table meeting on Tuesday 17 November. CAF lists kick-off in Greenwich Mean Time (GMT), which is five hours ahead of US Eastern time now that clocks have gone back.

 Monday 16 November 2026: Somalia v Ghana, 10:00 a.m. ET (15:00 GMT)
 Tuesday 17 November 2026: Gambia v Côte d’Ivoire, 11:00 a.m. ET (16:00 GMT) [...] Côte d’Ivoire’s 9 points are three clear of Gambia with three games left each, using CAF results to 12 November 2026. CAF said on 15 November that a win in Gambia on Tuesday 17 November would guarantee Côte d’Ivoire’s place at the finals.

A win would take them to 12 points with two games left. Ghana have 3 points from one win and two defeats, and their two games with Somalia are their way back into the race.
